en.headline: 9 commits across 2 repos, 2 issues opened, 1 discussion started
en.summary: sogeisetsu made 9 own commits across 2 repositories, plus 9 automated commits by github-actions[bot] in `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`. In `sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox` (7 commits), the work centered on documentation: adding `AGENTS.md` and noting the origin remote, creating a `knowledge/` base for Git & GitHub findings with Excalidraw sketches, generalizing the knowledge scope beyond Git/GitHub, archiving OpenCode V2 distribution/architecture/auth and Windows path pitfalls, archiving oh-my-opencode-slim and hosted OpenCode findings, and making knowledge supplementation a default action with adjustable architecture. In `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` (2 commits), two daily-report fixes were applied: tightening comment-count semantics and target lookup per review feedback, and fixing missed +08 early-morning replies while surfacing comment counts on Issue/PR rows. Two issues were opened in `anomalyco/opencode`: #55785 on `mimo-v2.6-flash`/`mimo-v2.5` advertising image input while the Go endpoint rejects every image with 400, and #55772 requesting a way to run the CLI bundled with the Windows desktop app. `micahgerges` replied on #55785 with a controlled 2x2 reproduction using a real OpenCode Go key from a server deployment, and `opencode-agent[bot]` responded on both issues.

zh.headline: 2 个仓库共 9 次提交，新开 2 个 issue，发起 1 个讨论
zh.summary: sogeisetsu 在 2 个仓库共完成 **9 次本人提交**，另有 9 次由 `github-actions[bot]` 在 `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` 自动提交。`sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox` 的 7 次提交以文档为主：新增 `AGENTS.md` 并记录 origin 远端，建立 `knowledge/` 目录归档 Git & GitHub 发现并附 Excalidraw 草图，将 knowledge 范围从 Git/GitHub 泛化为「各种知识」，归档 OpenCode V2 分发/架构/认证与 Windows 路径坑，归档 oh-my-opencode-slim 与托管 OpenCode 实测知识，并把 knowledge 补充改为默认动作、架构可随内容调整。`sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` 的 2 次提交修复日报脚本：按复审意见收紧评论数口径与 target 检索，并修复 +08 凌晨漏采回复、在 Issue/PR 行显示评论数。在 `anomalyco/opencode` 新开 2 个 issue：#55785 反映 `mimo-v2.6-flash`/`mimo-v2.5` 声明支持图片输入但 Go 端点一律返回 400，#55772 请求为 Windows 桌面版内置的 CLI 提供运行入口。`micahgerges` 在 #55785 用真实 OpenCode Go key 做了 2x2 对照复现，`opencode-agent[bot]` 在两个 issue 上均有回复。在 `openchamber/openchamber` 发起讨论 #4982「Share session archive state with OpenCode's own clients」。当日无 PR、无 review、无 release。
